Description
The University of Glasgow has been changing the world since 1451. It is one of the top 100 universities in the world and one of the largest research bases in the UK. Alumni include seven Nobel Prize winners, a Prime Minister and Scotland’s First Minister, while Honorary Graduate Albert Einstein gave a lecture on the theory of relativity back in 1933.
Glasgow International College offers degree preparation courses for international students planning to attend the University of Glasgow. The college is integrated with the University of Glasgow's beautiful campus in Scotland and provides international students with amazing opportunities to experience student life while preparing for their degree program at an elite university.
